title: YouTube — Problem Definition
subtitle: Global video processing and delivery at petabyte scale

panels.title: Functional Requirements
panels.body:
- Resumable chunked video upload
- Multi-resolution transcoding (360p - 4K)
- Adaptive Bitrate (ABR) streaming (HLS/DASH)
- Recommendation engine (collaborative/content)
- Content ID (copyright) & analytics

panels.title: Out-of-Scope
panels.body:
- Live streaming infrastructure (dedicated pipe)
- YouTube Music / TV specific features
- Ad serving & real-time auctions
- Advanced content moderation workflows
